title: GOAL: pipeline friction seen in luna-inbox M1 (fix-round deadlock, context-only rebase holds)
spec: Goal container, 2026-09-24. The luna-inbox M1 build (driven by this orchestrator) hit two pipeline defects repeatedly: (1) headless Planners filed fix rounds with depends_on = [their fix_round_for parent]; bus.ready needs merged_into, so they deadlocked (T-0051, T-0052, T-0063, T-0064; re-filed by hand); (2) merge.py held reviewed tasks as rebase_changed_diff after clean rebases that only shifted diff context (T-0047, T-0057; patch-id of reviewed and rebased commits equal). Tasks P1 (bus normalization) and P2 (merge patch-id) on goal branch from origin/main.
acceptance: P1 and P2 merged into goal/<this id> and the PR opened
